title: Listening Drill — Tablet stand return
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Tablet stand return
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with a tablet stand. The main problem is a loose hinge. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the item code. Then bring the item to the returns counter. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a repair estimate. fold the stand before carrying it. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
